hypotheses.hybrid: RRF improves first-rank evidence over dense; same top-3, budget and one-search limit isolate retrieval change.
hypotheses.expanded: Top-6, 10000 characters, text deduplication and up to two model-directed searches recover missing conditions at extra latency and cost. This is a combined pipeline experiment, not a causal ablation.

test_policy: Freeze the selected configuration and code hash after dev review; then evaluate baseline and selected on all seven test queries. Do not tune using test.
